description: Internal implementation file for xdgmime, defining functions for UTF-8 to UCS4 conversion, string manipulation, and internal data structures.

methods.name: _xdg_utf8_to_ucs4
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 encoded character to UCS4.

methods.name: _xdg_convert_to_ucs4
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 string to an array of UCS4 characters.

methods.name: _xdg_reverse_ucs4
methods.description: Reverses an array of UCS4 characters.
